definitions.explanation: The act of receiving orders from customers or clients for goods or services.

examples.japanese: {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{件数|けんすう}→件数：28808_kensuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えた→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of orders received this month increased.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}っている→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
examples.english: This factory manufactures products on a made-to-order basis.

notes:
{受注|じゅちゅう} means receiving an order from a customer or client. It is primarily a business term used in commercial and manufacturing contexts. The kanji combine ⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧ (to receive) and ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ (order).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to receive an order
- {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{件数|けんすう}→件数：28808_kensuu⟧: number of orders received
- {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{生産|せいさん}→生産：01444_seisan⟧: made-to-order production
- {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{残高|ざんだか}→残高：05422_zandaka⟧: order backlog
- {受注|じゅちゅう}⟦{額|がく}→額：02607_gaku⟧: total value of orders received

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {受注|じゅちゅう}: receiving orders (seller/supplier side)
- ⟦{発注|はっちゅう}→発注：05132_hacchuu⟧: placing orders (buyer/customer side)
- ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧: the order itself; also used in everyday contexts like restaurants

REGISTER:
Used in business, manufacturing, and formal contexts. For everyday ordering (at a restaurant, online shopping), ⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧ is more natural.
